craft_notes: Sthāyin: Rati for sight and stay (abhilāṣa) settling into praise. End-dash→colon: dreamers named, gift lands. Rejected: exclamation after 'yea' — plain hail kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Hail to them, yea, who dream-caught the crescent-crowned:
the Lord, the giver of unbound delight.
l4.sanskrit_cite: namas tebhyo 'pi ye somakalākalitaśekharam nāthaṃ svapne 'pi paśyanti paramānandadāyinam

reads_against.argmap: Homage to them even: who see the moon-crescent-crowned lord even in dream. → Homage to those who see the bliss-giving lord even in dreams.
c1_essence: Longing to see the deep and dwell in the cave; homage to dream-seers of the bliss-giver.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti-śānta with abhilāṣa (longing to see and stay)

l2.plain_english: Homage to them even — who see the moon-crested lord, giver of supreme bliss, even in dream.
